name: Banh hoi My Phong
summary: Bánh hỏi from Mỹ Phong is a product of the noodle village, named with bánh tét, bánh ít, hủ tiếu, and bánh tầm. The Tiền Giang tourism portal prints no serving. It is not the Phong Điền bowl.
origin: Phường Mỹ Phong. The Tiền Giang tourism portal lists it among the village products.
howToEat: The tourism portal names bánh hỏi as a village product and prints no serving.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. A serving hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa, phường Mỹ Phong, and old phường 9. The Đồng Tháp tourism portal prints the Hội Gia workshop as 07:00–18:00. That clock is the visit, not a stall.
seoTitle: Banh hoi from the My Phong village
